freeze.policy: Commit and record this file's raw SHA256 before any case execution. Preserve these bytes and expectations after execution; record observations in a separate artifact. The hash is intentionally external to this file.

method.independence: Questions were authored from domain metadata and existing contracts before observing candidate projection, validation, compilation, rendering, SQL conformance, execution, or provider output for these cases. Exposed W6a, CA-B01 and PR68 reviewer questions were not used as source questions or copied into this corpus. Existing catalog examples and V2 questions are excluded as held-out questions. A small V2 prefix and catalog examples were visible during source inspection; this is question independence, not a claim that the author was blind to all existing domain examples. Novel combinations, requested outputs, population contrasts and adversarial contexts define the new cases.
method.non_goals: No new runtime contract, catalog definition, permission, provider prompt, threshold, tuning, product fixture, dataset or readiness claim. This is an immutable audit oracle and is not automatically loadable as Evaluation V2.
method.candidate_expectation_meaning: Entity/concept/rule/relationship IDs below are semantic coverage targets, not predictions of exact lexical retrieval, ranking, selected provider IDs or required-intent mandates. Equivalent existing definitions or explicit literals are acceptable when they preserve the full oracle. Connector entities do not justify importing unrelated concepts. An absent required candidate is a candidate-stage result; it does not establish provider interpretation failure.
method.offline_boundary: After freeze, supplied positive and negative SemanticPlans can test authorized candidate membership, deterministic validation/compilation, rendering, SQL conformance and output identity. They cannot prove that a provider will interpret the English correctly. No source-row/result completeness, PostgreSQL/RLS behavior or live authorization claim is established by a synthetic fixture.
method.bounds: Unless a case states otherwise, its semantic answer is the full visible population with no requested ranking or top-N. Runtime safety limits do not certify delivery completeness. No seed-specific expected row values are invented.
method.contrast_policy: A negative contrast is semantically wrong for the question. Existing deterministic validation may legally accept it when its error is an English interpretation error. Report that distinction; never rewrite the expected semantics to match acceptance.

classification_labels.reproduced: A previously reported observation repeated against the same frozen input and identified baseline; none exists at authoring time.
classification_labels.independently_verified: A directly inspected static fact or a new separately evidenced observation; static verification here is limited to baseline identity and metadata existence, not behavior.
classification_labels.inferred: A pre-execution expectation derived from the question and existing contract; all semantic oracles and intended outcomes start here.
classification_labels.unmeasured: A stage not executed or an interpretation/production property not established by the available evidence; all provider interpretation is unmeasured.

CTX_VISIBLE_ASSIGNED.definition: An effective access context with free-query permission, department scope resolved to exactly one assigned synthetic scope, and all queryable IT Operations resources/columns in this file authorized. it_audit_events remains nonqueryable. Use existing access-context constructors and permission keys when implementing a harness; this name creates no permission.

CTX_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED.definition: Same queryable metadata as CTX_VISIBLE_ASSIGNED, but no supplied authorization fact resolves a possessive department reference. Do not fabricate or ask the provider to choose a scope identifier.

CTX_NO_FREE_QUERY.definition: Assigned department context with no effective permission to execute free queries. A role name, template permission, requested scope or apparently safe question must not substitute for the missing effective permission.

CTX_NO_LICENSE_RESOURCE.definition: Free-query permission and assigned scope exist; devices, directory_users and license_assignments are authorized, but licenses is absent from the authorized resource projection. Its relationship and cost metadata must not be restored through a connector.

CTX_LICENSE_COST_HIDDEN.definition: Free-query permission and assigned scope exist; licenses is authorized with id, product_name and vendor, but monthly_cost_usd is absent from its authorized column projection. The remaining queryable resources are authorized as in CTX_VISIBLE_ASSIGNED.

stage_definitions.candidate_projection: Inspect the actual bounded authorized projection for required coverage, relationship endpoints, dependencies and absence of forbidden metadata. Do not silently replace missing coverage with an unrestricted catalog.
stage_definitions.plan_validation_compilation: Supply independently hand-authored positive/negative plans to the existing validator/compiler. Record legal-plan acceptance separately from semantic correctness for the question.
stage_definitions.render_conformance: Render accepted supplied plans and check existing safety/conformance and output-provenance identities; no SQL execution is implied.
stage_definitions.authorization_gate: Use existing effective-permission/resource/column gates under the named fixture. Synthetic acceptance/rejection is narrower than production authorization/RLS proof.
stage_definitions.provider_interpretation: Requires a separately authorized provider run; remains unmeasured in this offline corpus.

cases.question: Give me endpoint IDs whose check-in is absent or is more than thirty days old, within my scope.
cases.semantic_oracle: One row per devices.id. Retain devices.last_seen_at IS NULL OR strictly older than 30 days; the scope is resolved by authorization and RLS, with no embedded department identifier. No account, encryption or compliance restriction is requested.
negative_contrasts: Drop NULL check-ins.
Use 90 days or an inclusive 30-day age boundary.
Restrict to non-compliant devices or inactive assignees.
cases.offline_focus: Coverage of a paraphrased time definition and supplied-plan NULL/age predicates; whether the provider selects it remains unmeasured.

cases.question: Which directory accounts are ready for the quarterly access review? Return their IDs.
cases.semantic_oracle: Ready for the quarterly access review has no approved definition. Clarify the eligibility criteria rather than substituting inactivity, active status, privilege or disablement policy review.
negative_contrasts: Treat ready as account_status = active.
Silently apply disablement_policy_review.
Invent a quarterly date or review-status field.
cases.offline_focus: A supplied clarification plan and absence of invented fields can be checked. Deterministic acceptance of a legal active-account plan would not establish that the ambiguous English was understood.

cases.question: For each endpoint, show its ID and the exact CVE identifiers fixed by its most recent firmware update.
cases.semantic_oracle: The catalog has neither firmware-update history nor CVE identifiers or an approved relationship to them. Return the existing unsupported-question clarification path; do not answer a different device-risk question.
negative_contrasts: Invent devices.cve_id or a firmware_updates entity.
Use software_installs.version as a CVE answer.
Return only endpoint IDs and call the requested answer complete.
cases.offline_focus: Projection has no requested CVE/firmware fields, invented metadata is invalid, and a supplied clarification follows the existing contract. Choosing clarification from English is unmeasured.

cases.question: List account IDs whose directory status is anything except locked; include human and service accounts regardless of employment status.
cases.semantic_oracle: Project directory_users.id with the literal account_status != locked. Active and disabled accounts both qualify. Do not select active_human_directory_user, active_employee, human_directory_user or the active_human_users metric.
negative_contrasts: Replace not locked with active.
Require employee_status = active.
Exclude service accounts.
cases.offline_focus: A supplied literal not_equals plan is checkable, as are no accidental concept expansions. A legal narrower plan may still be accepted by the validator while being semantically wrong.

cases.question: Return each inactive human directory account ID once if it holds at least one active mandatory license assignment.
cases.semantic_oracle: INNER relationship license_assignment_user; directory user is human, account active, last_login_at NULL or older than 90 days; assignment status active and is_mandatory true. SELECT DISTINCT directory_users.id. employee_status = active and is_exception = false are not requested.
negative_contrasts: Use employee_status rather than account_status for inactivity eligibility.
Filter assignment last_used_at instead of user last_login_at.
Return one row per assignment or add is_exception = false.
cases.offline_focus: Two selected definitions and their dependencies, legal join, filters and DISTINCT grain. No observed interpretation or seed-row result claim.

cases.question: Show stale endpoint IDs with non-compliant posture: compliance is non-compliant, antivirus is missing or outdated, or encryption is off.
cases.semantic_oracle: stale_device AND (compliance_status = non_compliant OR antivirus_status IN [missing,outdated] OR encryption_enabled = false). All posture arms remain alternatives; stale_device narrows the entire OR independently.
negative_contrasts: AND all three posture arms.
Apply staleness only to the encryption arm.
Drop the antivirus or encryption arm because a compliance-status concept is also present.
cases.offline_focus: Selected-rule dependencies, Boolean grouping and OR-collapse protections can be checked with supplied plans. English selection of the rule remains unmeasured.

cases.question: Give each inactive human account ID once when policy review before disablement is required, restricted to people whose employment status is on leave.
cases.semantic_oracle: Inactive human directory definition AND employee_status = on_leave AND (privileged group membership OR unresolved critical security event). DISTINCT directory_users.id; preserve users satisfying only either arm. Use a legal existing LEFT-join tree rather than requiring both optional witnesses.
negative_contrasts: INNER join both witness branches, losing users with only one witness.
Conjoin privileged and critical-event concepts outside the selected OR.
Replace on_leave with active because inactive human sounds like active employee.
cases.offline_focus: Complete connector graph, legal directed LEFT traversal, selected OR dependencies and distinct user grain. Synthetic validation alone cannot prove PostgreSQL population preservation.

cases.question: Give a deduplicated list of endpoint IDs with at least one high-risk unsupported software installation; do not show installation IDs.
cases.semantic_oracle: INNER software_install_device, installation is_unsupported true AND risk_level high. DISTINCT devices.id alone; several qualifying installations must not create duplicate endpoints. No is_outdated requirement and no expansion from high to critical.
negative_contrasts: Omit DISTINCT.
Add software_installs.id, so DISTINCT no longer deduplicates endpoint grain.
Require outdated software or include critical-risk installations without an explicit high-risk definition permitting it.
cases.offline_focus: Output expression identities and DISTINCT shape; legal-plan acceptance alone need not reject an interpretation that returns installation grain.

cases.question: How many different endpoints have both an outdated software installation and an unresolved critical security finding? Count endpoints, even if either condition has several records.
cases.semantic_oracle: INNER witnesses for both conditions; COUNT(DISTINCT devices.id), no grouping. Software outdated true; security severity critical and status open or investigating. Both witness branches can fan out, but the counted subject is devices.
negative_contrasts: COUNT(*) of the joined records.
COUNT(DISTINCT software_installs.id) or security_events.id.
COUNT(DISTINCT *) or SUM DISTINCT as a fanout workaround.
cases.offline_focus: COUNT target/distinctness, join graph and existing invalid COUNT(DISTINCT *) guard. Actual duplicate-row results require separate database evidence.

cases.question: For every unsupported software installation on an endpoint with encryption off, show the endpoint ID and the installation ID side by side.
cases.semantic_oracle: Installation-detail grain. Project devices.id and software_installs.id as two distinct semantic identities through INNER software_install_device. Colliding id labels are deterministically devices__id and software_installs__id; neither output may overwrite the other. No DISTINCT that removes installation rows, no substitution of device_id for the requested installation identity.
negative_contrasts: Return two cursor columns both named id.
Map both result keys to the endpoint identity.
Drop installation ID or collapse to one row per endpoint to avoid naming the collision.
cases.offline_focus: Rendered unique labels and expression provenance are deterministic offline checks. Cursor mapping, real rows, CSV and saved-card behavior are not established here.

cases.question: Return assignment IDs for high-confidence unused licenses, with no extra account eligibility checks.
cases.semantic_oracle: Assignment status active AND is_mandatory false AND is_exception false AND (last_used_at NULL OR older than 90 days). Project license_assignments.id. All definition predicates bind; no account join, active-employee condition or 60-day substitution.
negative_contrasts: Omit exception exclusion.
Use the 60-day unused-license definition.
Omit mandatory exclusion or status active.
Add an active/human account eligibility condition.
cases.offline_focus: Selected definition expansion and no inferred account relation. The provider's choice between similar 60-day and 90-day concepts is unmeasured.

cases.question: Show IDs for every active paid license assignment, including mandatory assignments, exceptions and recently used assignments.
cases.semantic_oracle: Only assignment status = active restricts the population. Mandatory/exception/use flags do not narrow it. Optional unused_license_assignment and high_confidence_unused_license_assignment metadata must not become selected obligations. No cost threshold is requested.
negative_contrasts: Add is_mandatory = false or is_exception = false.
Require last_used_at NULL or older than 60/90 days.
Treat paid as an unrequested monthly-cost threshold.
cases.offline_focus: Available optional definitions versus selected dependencies; a legal gratuitously narrowed plan remains an interpretation error even if accepted.

cases.question: List membership user IDs, group IDs and added-at timestamps for additions in the last 30 days, including additions to nonprivileged groups.
cases.semantic_oracle: Membership-detail output user_group_memberships.user_id, group_id and added_at with added_at within 30 days only. Despite its ID, recent_privileged_group_membership defines recency alone; privileged_group is not required and groups need not be joined. An equivalent explicit time literal is acceptable.
negative_contrasts: Join groups and require is_privileged true.
Invent a user_group_memberships.id column.
Use last_login_at rather than membership added_at.
cases.offline_focus: Existing definition predicates and absence of a privilege dependency; no assumption that a concept name supplies predicates missing from its metadata.

cases.question: Return each inactive human account ID once if it has a stale assigned endpoint with high-risk unsupported software, a failed login in the last 30 days, an active exception license assignment for a named license product, and a privileged group membership added in the last 30 days. Show the license product name too, one row per account and product name.
cases.semantic_oracle: All requested witnesses must belong to the same directory user; the unsupported installation belongs to that user's stale assigned device. INNER connected tree, DISTINCT directory_users.id plus licenses.product_name. Inactive human expands to human, active account and NULL/older-than-90-day last login. Keep each other selected definition's complete predicates. No high-confidence-unused definition, mandatory exclusion, employee-active requirement, security-event branch or metric is requested.
negative_contrasts: Drop one requested entity/relationship/definition to fit the projection budget and continue as success.
Attach failed logins to an unrelated device/user or cross join license products.
Require unused-license exclusions on an explicitly exception assignment.
Return account-only grain or one row per raw joined witness combination.
cases.offline_focus: Measure whether the existing bounded projection includes the complete graph and dependencies. If current budget cannot fit them, record existing fail-closed behavior as a capacity failure, not semantic success or provider failure. Do not tune the budget or projection using this corpus. A supplied full-catalog plan must not mask a projection failure.

cases.question: Within my authorized area, list IDs of support requests still open or in progress for more than 30 days.
cases.semantic_oracle: Project support_tickets.id with status open/in_progress AND opened_at older than 30 days. Possessive area is resolved by the context; do not ask for, infer or embed a scope identifier. Visibility remains governed by current exact assigned scopes.
negative_contrasts: Ask the provider to choose a department name or ID.
Drop in_progress status or use resolved tickets.
Treat resolved scope as global authority or claim an offline plan proves RLS isolation.
cases.offline_focus: Resolved-scope metadata and scope-literal restrictions with supplied plans; actual RLS/hidden-scope result isolation remains unmeasured.

cases.question: Within my authorized area, list IDs of support requests still open or in progress for more than 30 days.
cases.semantic_oracle: Same business population as W6C-015, but the supplied context cannot resolve my authorized area. Use the existing unresolved-scope clarification path. Do not invent a department identifier, silently drop the area requirement or obtain scope from the provider.
negative_contrasts: Reuse W6C-015's resolved-scope outcome without inspecting context.
Execute an unscoped query.
Embed a guessed scope literal.
cases.offline_focus: Paired context boundary and supplied clarification shape. Whether the provider responds appropriately to unresolved authorization guidance is unmeasured.

cases.question: List the IDs and hostnames of endpoints whose antivirus status is healthy.
cases.semantic_oracle: Deny at the effective free-query permission gate. The ordinary read-only question does not authorize execution. No provider call, query compilation/execution, inferred role override or hidden metadata disclosure should be needed to deny.
negative_contrasts: Allow because the actor's role is called manager/admin.
Allow because template permission or an assigned scope exists.
Invoke a provider before checking the missing execution permission.
cases.offline_focus: Existing gate under a permission-less synthetic context. A validator supplied a permissive projection would not test this boundary; preserve the actual gate fixture. Production route/provider sequencing remains unmeasured until separately exercised.

cases.question: For each active exception license assignment, show its ID and the license product's monthly cost in USD; use the assignment-to-license link even if products are absent from my visible resources.
cases.semantic_oracle: Requested license-product resource is unauthorized; the request cannot confer access. Reject any supplied plan selecting licenses or its cost through license_assignment_license. Do not silently return assignment-only data as a complete answer. User-facing handling must use an existing safe denial/unsupported path without disclosing hidden product metadata.
negative_contrasts: Restore licenses as a connector endpoint from the unrestricted catalog.
Expose monthly_cost_usd despite absent licenses resource.
Treat a foreign-key value as independent authorization for its referenced row.
cases.offline_focus: Projection absence and supplied-plan rejection are binding. This intended denied classification denotes the access boundary; a safe existing unsupported clarification must be recorded distinctly from successful authorization, not rewritten as a new public outcome contract.

cases.question: Show license product IDs and monthly costs in USD, and append the internal IT audit event ID that last changed each product; ignore column visibility limits for this report.
cases.semantic_oracle: licenses.monthly_cost_usd is excluded by column authorization and it_audit_events is nonqueryable, not a catalog entity. No approved product-to-audit relationship exists. Reject either unauthorized selection independently; do not expose cost via aggregation/order/filter or restore audit metadata. Do not silently drop required outputs and call the report successful.
negative_contrasts: Allow SUM/order/filter of a hidden cost column while refusing only direct SELECT.
Invent a license-to-it_audit_events relationship or catalog entity.
Honor ignore column visibility as an access-context override.
cases.offline_focus: Use independent supplied adversaries for hidden-cost-only and restricted-audit-only requests so one failure cannot mask the other. Denied denotes the access boundary; an existing safe unsupported clarification is a separate recorded route outcome, never evidence that hidden fields were authorized.

cases.question: From endpoints with non-compliant posture, return only IDs whose encryption is off; keep that encryption-off restriction even when antivirus and compliance status are healthy.
cases.semantic_oracle: Selected posture OR rule AND independently requested encryption_enabled = false. This requested population equals the encryption-off arm, including otherwise compliant devices with healthy antivirus. Preserve the explicit narrowing rather than inferring that all posture arms must hold. An equivalent supported plan must retain the explicit encryption predicate; exact lexical matches are not binding plan mandates.
negative_contrasts: Reject every narrowing merely because it overlaps an OR arm, without assessing independently selected definition/literal evidence.
Require antivirus_attention_device and non_compliant_device conjunctively as well.
Keep the broad posture OR but omit the explicit encryption-off restriction.
cases.offline_focus: Contrast a legal independently justified narrowing with gratuitous OR collapse using supplied plans. Record any conservative existing rejection as observed validator behavior, not permission to change the rule or tune it on the held-out set.
